What was checked—and what remains open

  • Board export: 4,146 cards, including 4,049 archived and 97 current cards. All titles/descriptions were screened; the export contains only the latest 1,000 actions, so it is not a complete archive of every historical comment.
  • 324 candidates were retained from corporate, reimbursement, postage, fee and advance-related requests. This includes outgoing/credit and process items to make exclusions reviewable. Requests mentioned only inside unread comments or attachments may still be missing.
  • Comment text captured does not certify that every attachment or every historical comment was examined. Inconsistent Trello card loading prevented completion of the remaining comment histories.
  • AppFolio Vendor Ledger was reviewed for the management-company payee Verandah Properties, LLC, with all properties and bill dates January 1, 2024–November 7, 2026. Reversed transactions were excluded by the report setting. Selected fee/reimbursement categories and all positive unpaid entries were extracted.
  • AppFolio “paid” is accounting evidence of an issued/recorded payment. No independent Corporate bank statement, cleared-check image or complete QuickBooks bank reconciliation was reviewed. This report therefore does not establish actual bank receipt for every paid entry.
  • Tenant charges that have not been collected may not generate a Corporate payable yet. A complete tenant unpaid-charge and allocation review is still needed for tenant-fee exceptions. Future-dated bills after November 7 are outside the report period and must not be classified as overdue from this report.
  • Property/date-window matches are preliminary. Confirm the requested lease/service period, amount and reversals; do not use a later annual fee to close an earlier request.
  • The earlier broad-audit vendor-bill amount of $10,263.81 is not the Corporate receivable total and is not carried into this report.
  • No funds were moved, bills changed, payments initiated, cards closed or messages sent during this review.

Evidence required to finish

  1. Corporate bank/QuickBooks transaction export for the advance and bulk-payout dates, including transfer reference, amount and posted date.
  2. Remaining archived comment histories and payment attachments; identify any requests absent from the title/description screen.
  3. Tenant unpaid charges and payment allocations for the specific fee requests, including waivers and reversals.
  4. Exact bill and payment evidence for Hill inspection, postage follow-ups and unresolved historical leasing-fee corrections.

Recommended closing rule: retain request, amount, bill/charge reference, payment date, check/ACH reference and Corporate bank-match evidence on each card. “Charge added,” “bill entered,” “Done” and “Archived” alone do not establish payment.
